sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydralazine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 280 tablets of the 10 mg presentation with 24.6 days on hand at current use.
Corvale General holds 391 tablets of the 10 mg presentation with 29.7 days on hand at current use.
The product label names Teva Czech Industries s.r.o. Opava-Komarov as the manufacturing plant.
The rule-based recommendation is to buy from Ascend Laboratories, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Ascend Laboratories, LLC's label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
